integration.notes: Approved white-frost and pale-blue ice with depth-soft cold mist; default color #d4e8ed, bloom 1.1 and shiny 1. Lance flies along +X into (2.6,1.5,0); contact ice patch removed. Shield mist is emitted across the curved face, drifts outward, and stops spawning when the shield breaks; the shield holds steadily without impact events, starts breaking at 3.4s, and retains group.position.y=0.6. Ground crystals erupt at full height, vapor replenishes while present, then ice fragments explode at 3.6s. Fixed seed; reset and seek retain particle identity. Transparent supports do not write depth. The render hook is required even at bloom=0 for soft mist intersections. Bloom keeps opaque mesh occlusion, uses four lazy render targets, and restores scene/renderer state. Three.js r187, WebGL2, SRGBColorSpace, NoToneMapping, opaque full-frame output. No automatic animation loop, collision, terrain edits or external texture fetch; transparent environment bloom occlusion and additional host postprocessing are not supported. dispose releases owned resources; subsequent calls are inert.
integration.renderHook: fx.render(renderer,scene,camera) replaces renderer.render; once per scene/frame, covers all ice instances
